_what: Everything the compositor needs, in physical units. Sizing comes from inches, never from ratios measured on a mockup.
_chain: print files are 300 dpi at final size: Salt Lake ink = 11.98 x 14.87 in, location text 0.70 in tall, identical on all three garments
length_in is the size-guide Length (collar to hem) for the size the model is wearing
collar and hem are marked on that garment's BASE photo and must be re-measured if the base is regenerated
px_per_inch = (hem - collar) / length_in; the art is drawn at px_per_inch / 300 of file size
_assumed_size: L. If the model reads as a different size, change length_in and every dimension rescales.
